MDD: same primary gross economic daily-close measure in both sides, not net fixed-allocation MDD
credit_interaction: Original gate remains NOT_RUN_GATE_FAILED; these are single-variable controls, not an alternative credit+drawdown strategy
matching: Only quarters with both groups. Difference of equal-asset group means within that exact quarter and stratum, then equal quarters. No outcome used to match. Singleton/no-opposite strata explicitly unavailable.
multiple_testing: 4 variables x 2 horizons x all fixed strata; exploratory, no promotion based on lucky cell
paired_SPY_residual: For US equities only SAME_EXECUTION benchmark labels; still not beta/volatility-risk-matched alpha.
strata: market x currency x economic class x return basis, never across incompatible local returns
why: Raw drawdown mean advantage shrank after date weighting; high-vol24m interval can reflect composition, common regimes or risk premium. Attack by within-quarter class contrasts, no parameter changes.
